stem: One cultivar shows a desirable response to a specific supplemental UV treatment. What is the most defensible recommendation?
choices: Treat the result as cultivar- and treatment-specific until replicated across relevant genotypes and conditions
Apply the same UV dose universally
Ignore total light exposure when repeating the treatment
Assume a stronger UV treatment will improve the response further
rationale: UV responses should not be universalized from a single cultivar or treatment. Replication and control of total light/environmental context are required.
